PC: Did the fellow comprehensively interview the patient?
Did the fellow comprehensively interview the patient’s wife? (e.g. ascertain corroborating history about memory deficits)
Did the fellow conduct an appropriate neurologic exam?
Did the fellow perform an adequate mental status evaluation? (e.g. orientation, multiple cognitive domains [short-term memory, language, visual-spatial, and executive function])
Did the fellow develop an appropriate management plan (including plan for driving evaluation)?
MK: Was the fellow able to organize a difficult and multi-faceted dementia case? (e.g. prioritize balance between history taking, cognitive assessment, and management plan?)
SBP: Did the fellow utilize the services of the interdisciplinary team?
ICS: Did the SP feel respected by the physician?
Did the physician treat the patient well?
Did the SP understand the physician’s questions?
Did the SP understand the physician’s answers?
Did the physician engage all parties (patient, his wife, and Medical Social Worker/Nurse?)
Did the SP feel that she played an active role in decision making?
Did the fellow comprehensively interview the Medical SW/RN?
Fellow was able to communicate the issues and plan appropriate with patient using shared decision making (when appropriate)?
PROF: Did the physician wash their hands?
